summary: All 67 walkthrough scenes re-captured on the closed round: 24 of the 34 findings are fixed, 8 are partly fixed with the packets' own recorded limits, and 2 were observations no packet took.
method: One build: cargo build -p oneterm-app --profile fast-dev from the worktree at main e66f76e8, launched once (pid 4564, hwnd 12258436) with USERPROFILE/HOME pointed at the walkthrough's own scratch home so the shell prompt and known_hosts match the before frames; target/{docks,ssh_session,terminal,ui_config,update_config}.json were seeded from the walkthrough's cfgbak/ so the session tree holds the same DevServer (#56B6C2) and PAM (#7F1D1D) entries, the UI font size is 16 and the theme is Zed One Dark. The desktop is locked, so every frame is PrintWindow(hwnd, dc, PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) of that one process and every input was a posted WM_* message, driven by the walkthrough's own gui.ps1. Only that pid's windows were ever addressed (EnumWindows + GetWindowThreadProcessId) and only that pid was closed; the Settings window is a second top-level window of the same pid (hwnd 5377686) and the 1016x708 frames are captures of it. Window sizes match the before frames exactly: 1600x1000 for scenes 01-49 (checked programmatically for all 67), 1016x708 for the Settings frames, 900x800 for 50 and 1900x1040 for 51-59. The SFTP, host-key and connect scenes ran against the repository's loopback sftp-dev-server on 127.0.0.1:2266 (the before walk used 2222, so the host string in 43 and the tab title in 44-49 read 2266); the failure path used 10.10.10.10, as before. What could not be driven: no Ctrl/Shift chord and no double-click can be delivered by posted messages, so the in-terminal search bar was reached by temporarily rebinding Find to F2 through the app's own Key Bindings page and resetting it to ctrl-f afterwards (verified on screen), and tab rename was reached through the new context menu rather than by double-click; real hovers do not hold long enough for the kit's tooltip delay, so the Aa/W tooltips are still uncaptured; a real splitter drag does not reach the kit's resize handle. The loopback server was stopped and target/fast-dev deleted after the walk.

01-first-launch.note: The single tab now reads Command Prompt instead of Terminal (F1), the session hosts and the search placeholder are legible (F6), and the Session header carries a + button that was not there before (F8).

02-plus-menu.note: The closing rows are now Quick Connect... (Ctrl+Shift+N) and New Saved Session..., so the label names the dialog it opens (F7); the shell rows and the SSH Sessions block above them are unchanged, as the owner's row order requires.

03-plus-menu-kbdnav.note: Arrow-key navigation still works; the first Down now highlights the first row (Command Prompt) and a second Down reaches PowerShell, which is what this frame shows. Unchanged otherwise.

04-two-tabs.note: Two tabs read Command Prompt and PowerShell rather than two identical Terminal labels (F1).

05-typing.note: Unchanged; terminal rendering, colours and reflow behave as before. The tab strip above it is now named.

06-terminal-context-menu.note: Unchanged in content; the shortcut hints beside the rows are now legible (F6).

07-split-right-empty-space.note: The placeholder leads with Right-click -> New Terminal Here and demotes the drag/split line (F25); the active Space carries a 2 px accent ring instead of 1 px and the inactive Space carries a small #0 chip (F26). The status bar still collapses to the clock (F27, unchanged by design).

08-empty-space-menu.note: Same menu as before; New Terminal Here is now advertised by the placeholder behind it (F25). No shell submenu, by a decision recorded in US-0115.

09-split-two-terminals.note: The two Spaces are now told apart by a 2 px ring on the active one plus a #N chip on the inactive one, not by a single pixel (F26).

10-session-context-menu.note: Reordered to Open / Properties / separator / New Session / separator / Delete, with Delete in the danger colour and the global New Session out of the top slot; Property is now Properties (F24). Duplicate and Move to Group are still absent (declined in US-0119).

11-session-property-dialog.note: The colour control is a labelled eight-swatch row with Custom... instead of an unlabelled square (F21); Jump host, Port forwards and Agent forwarding are folded into an Advanced disclosure, so the footer sits at y~745 instead of y~830 (F20); the Logging block's descenders are whole (F19).

12-session-dialog-privatekey.note: With Private Key selected the form is about 700 px tall and Save is at y~813 in a 1000 px window, where the before frame had it at y~900 (F20). Private Key's y is no longer clipped (BUG-0069's wider fix).

12b-session-dialog-agent.note: Same shortening; the agent-forwarding checkbox now lives under Advanced and its label no longer clips (F19, F20).

13-new-ssh-session-dialog.note: Reached from the + menu's Quick Connect... row, which now names this dialog honestly (F7). The dialog itself is unchanged.

14-quick-connect-filled.note: Unchanged: host 10.10.10.10, user demo, a password typed and Save to SSH Sessions ticked.

15-connect-inflight.note: Unchanged: Connecting is disabled, Cancel stays live. The password field now keeps its value instead of being cleared the moment Connect is pressed (F4).

15b-connect-15s.note: Unchanged; still in flight at 15 s with the password still in the field.

16-connect-failed.note: The dialog stays open with the password intact and shows the failure inline: SSH connect failed: timed out after 20 s, prefixed once (F3, F4), plus an explicit line that the session was not saved and why (F5).

17-connect-timeout-20s.note: Same state as 16 two seconds later; the toast in the corner also reads the failure once (F3).

17b-connect-timeout-22s.note: The doubled prefix is gone: the toast reads SSH connect failed: timed out after 20 s, not SSH connect failed: SSH connect failed: ... (F3).

18-completion-overlay.note: Unchanged; the overlay, its prefix highlighting and the command tag behave as before.

18c-completion-ps.note: Unchanged; history completion in PowerShell behaves as before. The inactive Space's #1 chip is the only new chrome.

19-many-tabs.note: Ten tabs, all named after their shell (F1); the leftmost tab keeps part of its label instead of collapsing to a bare close cross (F11). Overflow chevrons are still absent -- upstream TabBar, recorded in US-0116.

20-tabbar-more-menu.note: The ... menu now carries a Terminal Tabs list of up to nine tabs with a tick on the active one (F13); the Zoom In row below it is the kit's own and cannot be removed or reworded from the OneTerm side (upstream, recorded in US-0116).

21-tabbar-4th-button.note: Closing the dock with the tab bar's 4th button now moves the title-bar segmented control to None, so it no longer claims SSH Client while the dock is shut (F2).

22-agent-panel.note: The Agent mode has an Agents header matching the Session / SFTP Browser headers, and the empty state reads in plain language with the protocol identifier demoted to a dimmed footnote (F28).

24a-dock-collapsed-via-button.note: Same collapsed dock; the segmented control reads None, not SSH Client (F2).

24b-after-clicking-sshclient-again.note: Clicking SSH Client now reopens the dock with the same panel and width; the before frame showed nothing happening at all (F2).

25-app-menu.note: About is F1 and Quit is Ctrl+Shift+Q; the single-Ctrl keys are freed for the terminal (F31). The menu is still the only menu, which F33 records as an observation.

26-settings-general.note: General is a real landing page -- Theme (Mode, Color Theme), Interface (UI Font Size) and Shell -- instead of one field on an empty page, and no group states its own name three times (F16). The sidebar lists twelve short pages and fits the 708 px window collapsed (F15, partly).

27-settings-keybindings.note: Rows at their default print the binding once, with no Default: ... line under it; the chips are legible (F32). New SSH Session is Ctrl+Shift+N, About is F1, Quit is Ctrl+Shift+Q and Toggle Gutter is unbound (F31).

28-settings-terminal.note: Terminal now holds only Font and Cursor, so the page fits the window; the header/title/description triple-naming is cut to two levels (F14, F16).

29-settings-ssh.note: SSH keeps Connection and SFTP Editor and now fits the window without hunting.

30-settings-completion.note: Completion is its own page rather than the tenth group of a long Terminal page, so the sidebar row reaches it in one click -- the before frame showed that click landing on Font (F14). It still needs a short scroll for its last three items, recorded in US-0122.

30b-settings-sidebar-logging.note: Logging is now the Terminal Logging page and the sidebar row lands on it, where before it landed mid-Font (F14).

31-settings-appearance.note: Replacement surface. The Appearance page no longer exists: US-0122 folded its two groups onto General, so this frame shows General with its sidebar sub-items expanded (Theme / Interface / Shell) and no Appearance row anywhere in the twelve-page sidebar. Mode and Color Theme are the Theme group at the top of the page.

32-theme-dropdown.note: The list opens under a Dark themes heading with the current theme, Zed One Dark, as the first selectable row carrying the tick, instead of opening at the top of about forty interleaved entries with the tick off-screen (F18). Light and dark are separate sections.

33-theme-light-settings.note: The Settings window in light mode; secondary text on it now meets the 4.5:1 floor (F6).

34-theme-light-main.note: The main window in the same default light theme as the before frame. Inactive tab labels (2.18:1 before) and session host text (2.37:1 before) are legible (F6); the tabs are also named after their shells (F1).

35-settings-about.note: About is Application / Links / Updates; Proxy URL and Verify Certificates have moved to their own Network page, which the sidebar shows between SSH and About (F17).

36-settings-about-updates.note: The Updates group now carries a Check for Updates row with a Check Now button -- the same action the About dialog offers -- so the update action and its settings are on one surface (F17).

36b-settings-about-end.note: Same page scrolled to its end; no Network group remains on it (F17).

37-about-dialog.note: Unchanged; Check for Updates is still here, and the same action is now also on the Settings About page (F17).

38-keybindings-edit-menu.note: Clicking the Edit Menu sub-item still leaves the page scrolled at App Menu -- the upstream scroll defect is untouched -- but the page now holds only two groups, so Edit Menu is on screen without navigating (F14, partly). Default-only rows print their binding once (F32).

39-keybinding-capture.note: Capture still replaces the whole row, which F32's third symptom names and no packet proposed changing; Esc still cancels.

40-search-bar.note: The counter is blank before a query instead of reading 0/0 (F34). The Aa and W toggles are unchanged; they already carried tooltips, which a posted-message walk cannot make appear. No regex toggle -- declined in US-0115.

41-search-matches.note: With System typed the counter reads 1/6 and all matches are tinted with the active one brighter, as before (F34's counter half).

42-search-scrollback.note: Unchanged; stepping matches still scrolls the viewport through the full scrollback.

43-hostkey-prompt.note: Unchanged -- the walkthrough named this one of the surfaces that already works. The host reads 127.0.0.1:2266 because this walk used port 2266; the before frame used 2222.

44-sftp-connected.note: The docked table now shows Name / Size / Date Modified with no horizontal scrollbar and Size visible at the default dock width; before, Size was not visible at all and the table scrolled (F29).

45-sftp-context-menu.note: The right-click menu is now the same list, in the same order, with the same icons as the ... menu (F30's consistency half); Edit and Refresh are on both.

46-sftp-delete-confirm.note: Unchanged -- the walkthrough named this the pattern the session tree should copy, and US-0119 copied it.

47-sftp-expanded.note: The dual pane carries the transfer controls the before frame had none of: Upload at the local pane's inner edge and Download at the remote pane's inner edge (F30). Neither pane scrolls horizontally and the local pane's always-empty fourth column is gone (F29).

48-sftp-overflow-menu.note: The ... menu renders the same shared action list as the right-click menu, plus a labelled Columns chooser holding the three columns that moved off the default (F29, F30).

49-sftp-after-tab-switch.note: Unchanged; switching to a local tab still returns the browser to No SFTP connection. The tabs are now named after their shells (F1).

50-narrow-900.note: At 900 px the dock takes 35 % (about 317 px) rather than an absolute 490 px, so the terminal keeps the majority (F9); the status-bar path elides from the left and keeps the tail the user is in, and MEM keeps its MB (F10). The before frame had three tabs here and this one has ten, because the walk reached this width later.

51-large-1900.note: At 1900 px the dock takes the user's remembered width; the tab strip is no longer clipped at the left (F11).

52-session-empty-area-menu.note: Right-clicking the blank area below the list now produces a New Session menu; before, it produced nothing at all (F8).

53-new-session-from-tree.note: The full New SSH Session dialog, now also reachable from the + menu's New Saved Session... row (F7), with the labelled colour row (F21) and the Advanced disclosure (F20).

54-session-color-picker.note: Replacement surface. The 130-swatch popup is no longer the colour control: the labelled eight-swatch row is, and the full picker now lives behind Custom... -- this frame shows both, with the picker's own featured top row reduced to the same eight (F21). The swatches are not tab stops; the picker beside them is the keyboard route, recorded in US-0120.

55-group-combobox.note: The group combobox with the list open; the no-match area now carries text rather than a bare inbox icon (F22).

56-group-typed.note: Typing Lab shows No groups yet. Type a name to create one. above the Create "Lab" row, where the before frame showed a bare icon (F22).

57-session-tree-with-group.note: The group disclosure is a chevron, not the diagonal maximise arrow the app uses for zoom (F23); Enter in the combobox created the group and closed the dropdown, which it did not do before (F22).

58-tab-rename-dialog.note: The Rename Tab dialog, reached from the tab context menu's Rename... row. The before frame is the unchanged workspace, because double-click is the only route the old build had and posted messages cannot deliver one (F12).

59-tab-context-menu.note: A tab now has a context menu -- Rename... / Duplicate / Close / Close Others / Close to the Right -- where before right-clicking only activated the tab (F12). The menu acts on the right-clicked tab and does not activate it.

F1.note: Local-shell tabs are named after their shell (Command Prompt, PowerShell) instead of all reading Terminal; an OSC 0/2 title still wins where a shell sets one.

F2.note: Closing the dock with a dock button moves the segmented control to None, and clicking a mode always reopens the dock with the same panel instance and width.

F3.note: A failed connect reads SSH connect failed: timed out after 20 s once, in the toast and in the new inline error.

F4.note: The dialog stays open with the typed password intact and states the failure inline, so a retry costs one click rather than a re-typed password.

F5.note: The dialog now says the session was not saved and why, with the tick left on; saving before a successful connect was declined in the packet's Decisions (CORR-54 stands).

F6.note: Secondary text reaches at least 4.5:1 on every surface it is drawn on in all 24 built-in theme files (39 variants), enforced by scripts/check-theme-contrast.py in CI.

F7.note: The + menu row reads Quick Connect... and a New Saved Session... row opens the full dialog, so the label names the dialog you get; merging the two dialogs was declined as a separate outcome.

F8.note: The Session header carries a + and the blank area below the list has a New Session context menu.

F9.note: The dock is capped at 35 % of the window with a 240 px floor, so at 900 px the terminal keeps the majority; below about 685 px the floor takes over, which US-0113 records as its stated choice.

F10.note: The cwd elides from the left at a separator and keeps the directory the user is in, the git branch keeps its head, and MEM keeps its unit.

F11.note: The leftmost tab no longer clips to a bare close cross and the strip has a tab list, but overflow chevrons belong to the kit's TabBar and cannot be added from the OneTerm side (US-0116 Evidence; the upstream follow-up is owed and was not filed).

F12.note: A tab has Rename... / Duplicate / Close / Close Others / Close to the Right, acting on the right-clicked tab, with confirmation on the bulk rows.

F13.note: The ... menu now carries the tab list it needed, but the kit appends its own Zoom In row after the panel's rows and owns the string, so the duplication and the wording stay (US-0116 Evidence, recorded in docs/gui-layout.md).

F14.note: Each page now holds two or three groups so every group is reachable, but a sub-item click still does not scroll to its group: the upstream gpui-component defect is untouched and the split routes around it (US-0122 Evidence; upstream report written in its Handoff, not filed).

F15.note: The caret collapses a group and the sidebar fits the 708 px window collapsed and with one page open, but the row itself still navigates rather than toggling -- the kit passes click_to_open(true) -- and the sidebar overflows with several pages expanded (US-0122 acceptance, graded partial).

F16.note: General is Theme / Interface / Shell rather than one field, and no page states its own name three times.

F17.note: Proxy URL and Verify Certificates have their own Network page and the Settings About page has a Check Now button running the same action as the dialog.

F18.note: The list opens under Dark themes / Light themes headings with the current theme first and ticked; the kit cannot open a popup scrolled to its checked row, so ordering is the mechanism, and the first Down-arrow still highlights the heading (US-0121 Gaps).

F19.note: Checkbox and radio labels render their descenders whole through a shared control_label; the finding's own diagnosis was wrong -- the Logging heading was never clipped, the controls were -- and two sftp-ui sites with the same cause are still unfixed (BUG-0069 Gaps).

F20.note: The FormDialog body scrolls and Jump host / Port forwards / Agent forwarding fold into an Advanced disclosure that opens itself when the session uses them, so Save stays on screen.

F21.note: The control is a labelled eight-swatch row with Custom... for the full picker; the swatches are not tab stops, and the picker beside them is the keyboard route (US-0120 Gaps).

F22.note: Enter creates the typed group and closes the dropdown, and the no-match area reads No groups yet. Type a name to create one.; Enter with a match highlighted is deliberately unchanged (US-0118 Gaps).

F23.note: A group discloses with a chevron instead of the diagonal maximise arrow the app uses for zoom.

F24.note: The menu is Open / Properties / separator / New Session / separator / Delete with Delete in the danger colour and a confirmation; Duplicate and Move to Group are still absent, declined in US-0119 as new capabilities needing their own packets.

F25.note: The placeholder leads with Right-click -> New Terminal Here; the second half of the finding -- that the item spawns the default shell with no picker -- is unchanged by a decision recorded in US-0115.

F26.note: The active Space carries a 2 px accent ring and each inactive Space a small #N chip with the shell on its tooltip; the chip's tooltip reads the raw session title rather than the tab label, recorded in US-0117 Gaps.

F27.note: Unchanged and unpacketed: with an empty Space active the status bar still collapses to the clock, which docs/gui-layout.md documents as intended.

F28.note: The Agent mode has an Agents header matching the SSH Client headers and plain-language empty-state copy; one mention of OSC 20308 stays as a dimmed footnote on the owner's instruction, and a link out was declined.

F29.note: The docked table defaults to Name / Size / Date Modified with Name measured against the panel, so nothing scrolls horizontally at any dock width and the local pane's empty fourth column is gone; the other columns are behind a Columns chooser.

F30.note: Each pane has Upload / Download at the edge facing the other, and both menus render one shared action list; uploading onto an existing remote file still overwrites without asking and menu items are never greyed out (US-0124 Gaps).

F31.note: New SSH Session is ctrl-shift-n, Quit ctrl-shift-q, About f1 and Toggle Gutter unbound, with a migration that only rewrites users still on the old defaults; that the freed keys now reach the shell is unverified, because posted messages set no modifier state (DEC-0018 Consequences).

F32.note: The chip meets the contrast floor and a row at its default prints its binding once; entering capture still replaces the whole row, which P11 did not propose and US-0121 records as out of scope.

F33.note: Unchanged and unpacketed: OneTerm is still the only menu, and the absent Edit/View/Help menus are a deliberate choice recorded in app_menus.rs.

F34.note: The counter is blank until a query exists and a distinct No matches state replaces 0/0; the Aa and W toggles turned out to carry tooltips already, and the regex toggle was declined in US-0115 as a new capability P14 did not propose.
